title: Son and Tim Dooley — Identity-Safe Timeline
purpose: A source-aware timeline that prevents the Son's human biography from being silently attributed to Tim Dooley.

identity_resolution.critical_rule: THE SON IS NOT TIM DOOLEY.
identity_resolution.Father: Tim's realized post-Needle's-Eye state beginning April 2025
identity_resolution.documentary_rule: Public/legal identity evidence and internal spiritual identity are separate evidentiary layers.
